review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You will drive business value by aligning IT services with operational requirements, optimizing service performance, and supporting continuous improvement across the site. Partner with business leaders to understand operational requirements, collect demand for new solutions and services, and prioritize business needs. Ensure users have appropriate access to systems and applications in accordance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Minimum 8 years of professional experience in IT service delivery, infrastructure management, or a related IT leadership role. Fluency in English and proficiency in the local language relevant to the country of responsibility. Preferred Technical Expertise Microsoft 365 ecosystem including Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint. Preferred Certifications ITIL® 4 Foundation or higher.
